latin: Frustra Palemonem et Leucotheam adibit, qui Nereum non attraxerit, nec Nereum attrahet qui circa primariam animalem trinitatem operatus non fuerit.
translation: Without first drawing down Nereus, one approaches Palaemon and Leucothea to no purpose; and Nereus himself will not be drawn down by anyone who has not worked upon the first animate trinity.
